quality_notes: The Government Printer PDF is an 11-page scan with no text layer, so this tree is parsed from an offline OCR reading. Wording has not been proof-read against the scan.
This tree is the least reliable of the six in the package and should not be relied on before it is proof-read. The damage is structural, not just spelling: see known_ocr_defects.

The body carries duplicate section numbers. Two further nodes numbered 1 and 2 appear after section 5, produced by the Form VIII / Form X specimen text of the Second Schedule being read as numbered sections. They are schedule forms, not sections of the Act.

Several section headings have swallowed whole runs of body text where the marginal-note column was not separated cleanly. Section 2's heading in particular runs to roughly a page of the substituted section 32(1).

Common letter substitutions through the body: 'thc' for 'the', 'thercof' for 'thereof', 'repcal' for 'repeal', 'scction' for 'section', 'hcreinafter' for 'hereinafter', 'Attomey' for 'Attorney', 'wiuness' for 'witness', 'LO' for 'to', 'Actmayl' for 'Act may', 'isnott' for 'is not'.
